messages:
alexa: Quick sync — I'm proposing a 'micro-beta' pilot: 6 high-touch partners, 3-week engagements, staggered starts (one-on-one onboarding windows) so we can iterate on onboarding friction and SLA differentiation. Want to capture both product fit and ops cost signals. Thoughts?

josh: +1. Do we have clear acceptance criteria per partner or uniform criteria?

alexa: Prefer per-partner success criteria + a small set of global pass/fail gates. Global: onboarding < 48h, mean p95 latency within target, and no untriaged regressions on core prompts. Individual: partner-specific task completion rates and qualitative CS score.

maria: For onboarding <48h we need a streamlined runbook and a single-run checklist. I can draft an "onboard triage playbook" with decision trees for common failures.

devin: Important: lock the model variants we serve for each partner so we can compare. Suggest we default to v1.quant and allow two opt-ins: higher-quality float model and lower-cost q4f. Scope: support prefix caching and a standard prompt shim.
samir: UX feedback plan — I'll run 30-minute moderated sessions with 3 partners each week, capture task flows, and create a short rubric. Can we record sessions? Need partner consent + opt-out.

claire: CS can run onboarding calls and collect partner KRs. I suggest a weekly status template: 1) usage, 2) blocker, 3) ask from Redwood. I'll coordinate invites.

josh: Incentives? Partners prefer credits + early roadmap visibility. We should offer a short SLA uplift for the pilot (faster queueing) and a small stipend.

alexa: Agree on incentives. Also want to test tiered SLAs within the cohort (2 partners get SLO-boost for 1 week) to measure delta in ops load and partner happiness.

maria: Ops implications noted. We'll need an escalation matrix and one person on rotation during each partner window. Who can cover rotation?
devin: I can cover week 1 rotation for infra issues. Will need a script that runs health checks and can toggle fallback policy to low-cost variant.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: micro-beta kickoff doc due in 48h -> /docs/microbeta-kickoff (auto-reminder) :bell:

alexa: For feedback loops: 1) automated metrics (latency, errors, token cost per request) 2) structured prompt evals we run nightly 3) qualitative CS survey at end of week 2. Example eval snippet below:
```
prompt_set: onboarding_tasks_v2
metrics: [exact_match, semantic_score, hallucination_flag]
schedule: nightly-run at 02:00 UTC
report: slack + dashboard
```

samir: Can we add short in-product feedback hooks so partners can flag confusing outputs? A small floating button that sends context + last user input would be gold.

alexa: Yes, include in scope as "optional instrumentation" — prioritized after onboarding reliability.

josh: Launch criteria (canary->all cohort): No P0s for 72h in canary partner, automated eval pass-rate >= baseline, onboarding flow reproducible by ProdOps in <= 2 tries. Otherwise rollback.

claire: Data & compliance note: partners will sign a short pilot NDA and a data handling addendum. CS will handle signatures. No data will be used for model training without explicit consent.

maria: Timeline proposal: week 0 = recruit + docs + NDAs, week 1 = staggered starts (2 partners), week 2 = next 2 partners, week 3 = final 2 partners + wrap and retrospective.

alexa: Sounds good. Action items: Maria draft runbook (due +36h), Samir schedule sessions & consent flow (+48h), Devin prepare toggle script and variant pins (+72h), Claire start NDA track and invite calendar + onboarding templates (+24h). I'll assemble kickoff doc and send invites.

josh: Also let's record a short internal demo for Eng & SRE so they understand the SLO toggles. I can do that after the kickoff doc.

ops-bot: Action recorded: Maria(runbook), Samir(ux-sessions), Devin(toggle-script), Claire(nda-track), Josh(demo), Alexa(kickoff-doc) — due dates auto-assigned.

alexa: Thanks all. We'll use this thread as the asynchronous source of truth until kickoff doc lands. If nobody objects by EOD I'll lock the cohort plan and post the kickoff link here. :thumbsup:
